recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中第 15 與 17 號染色體各有一條被圈起來：一條 15 號長臂較長、一條 17 號長臂變短，代表兩者長臂互換的平衡易位 t(15;17)(q24;q21)，形成 PML::RARA，是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的定義性異常。
features: G-banded karyotype with 46 chromosomes and XY sex chromosomes (male)
Circled chromosome 15 pair: one homolog with an abnormal, slightly longer long arm, the derivative 15
Circled chromosome 17 pair: one homolog with a shortened, altered long arm, the derivative 17
Reciprocal exchange of 15q and 17q material consistent with t(15;17)(q24;q21)
No marker chromosome or other numerical abnormality in this metaphase
describe_en: This G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow culture shows a male metaphase with 46 chromosomes. One chromosome 15 and one chromosome 17 are circled: the derivative chromosome 15 carries additional distal long-arm material, and the derivative chromosome 17 shows a shortened long arm, consistent with a balanced reciprocal translocation 46,XY,t(15;17)(q24;q21). No additional structural or numerical abnormalities are apparent in this cell. This rearrangement generates the PML::RARA fusion and is diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia; FISH or RT-PCR is recommended because cryptic insertions can produce PML::RARA with a normal-appearing karyotype, and to establish a baseline for molecular monitoring.

ddx.dx: APL variant RARA translocations, e.g., t(11;17)(q23;q21) ZBTB16::RARA
ddx.vs: Involve chromosome 11 rather than 15 and are ATRA-resistant, so the partner chromosome must be confirmed.

ddx.dx: Cryptic PML::RARA insertion with normal karyotype
ddx.vs: Karyotype appears normal, but FISH or RT-PCR detects the fusion.
Other recurrent balanced rearrangements involve chromosomes 8/21 or 16, not 15/17.
